purpose: The medium case: the two-site portfolio evaluated against the MESHED two-feeder synthetic fixture (one substation, two LV feeders, two mesh ties) - the 19.3 'multiple feeders/sites connected through a common substation constraint' case at fixture scale, balanced only, under the adapter's declared TopologyScope::RadialAndMeshed (P4.34). Exercises the pipeline's translation and completeness gates over a meshed model.
benchmark_reference: 19.3 bullet 4: multiple feeders/sites connected through a common substation constraint (fixture scale, balanced)
runtime_class: seconds-class on the scripted backend; the worker leg adds one process spawn per grid check; NOT a measured figure

forecast_fixture.note: the P3.31 synthetic central forecast fixture (presence + version validated here; consumption is the real-solve leg, VERIFY-BUILD)

grid_model.statement: the meshed two-feeder synthetic fixture (one substation, two LV feeders behind their own transformers, two mesh ties closing the ring); BALANCED only under the adapter's declared TopologyScope::RadialAndMeshed (P4.34); a NAMED fixture under that scope; SYNTHETIC - no IEEE feeder is used or claimed (19.3)

objective_config.note: the declared objective set (P3.14) has exactly one entry; the sim-runner composition does not solve - the objective config pins what a real-solve leg (VERIFY-BUILD) would consume; D1/D2 OPEN

statements: the grid-model fixture is the NAMED meshed two-feeder fixture (model id 'synthetic-meshed-two-feeder'); the coverage statement declares both feeders and the bus_3/bus_5 asset elements
site-north assets apply at bus_3 (feeder-a) and site-south assets at bus_5 (feeder-b) - the common-substation constraint at fixture scale
replay identity (double-run): verdict 'identical' on the scripted backend (the fixture backend is model-shape-agnostic and byte-stable)
the grid check remains a recorded FIXTURE outcome on the scripted backend (NOT a computed power flow); a computed evaluation of the meshed fixture requires the worker leg (UNRUN)
BALANCED only: unbalanced three-phase modelling is NOT claimed (enters from v0.4.0, D3 OPEN; P4.34 deferral record)

controls.neutralization: no wall clock is read in any run path; every instant is the scenario clock via the controlled RunClock (P0.09 s5); ingest_time is excluded from comparison by record shape (P2.13 s3)
comparison orders are deterministic (compare.rs sorts on the frozen identity tuple); run-record maps are BTreeMap; asset identities derive in scenario-file order
pinned thread_count = 1 in the solver configuration (the P3.26 pin block, scenarios-phase3; DEFAULT_REPLAY_TOLERANCE 1e-9); the sim-runner composition is single-threaded in-process
all run identities are deterministic FNV-1a-64 derivations (stand_in_asset_id, deterministic_uuid); the pinned master seed is the only randomness source
the scripted grid backend is a recorded fixture and byte-stable; a worker_process leg is tolerance-bounded (relative 1e-9, floor 1e-12) with the provider pin recorded per run

solver_pins.class: LP/QP/MILP (never SOCP - AGENTS.md rule 4); not exercised by the sim-runner composition (the real-solve leg is VERIFY-BUILD)
continuous conic incl. SOCP; no integer variables; not exercised by the sim-runner composition
AC power flow evaluation of specified injections (never an AC-OPF; AGENTS.md rule 4)

ieee_case_record.reason: excluded: no IEEE 13/34/123-bus distribution or 39/118-bus transmission model is available in this repository, and neither licensing nor model availability is confirmed (19.3; the 14_15_adapters.md feeder-case record). All cases are SYNTHETIC fixtures. The per-case record is mandatory; the exclusion is the honest entry, and a future inclusion requires the confirmed license/availability recorded here first.
